name: Mutt Coupon Gifts for WooCommerce
author: Mutt Group / Mutt Studio

sections.description:
Create a coupon that adds free products to the customer’s cart. Example: “Buy X and get Y for free with coupon GIFT”.

  • New “Free Gift” discount type. Gifts can also be added to percentage and fixed amount coupons.
  • Several gift products per coupon (up to 50), each with its own quantity, in the order you choose.
  • Simple, variable (choose a specific variation), digital (virtual or downloadable) and grouped products. A grouped product adds every product in the group.
  • Gifts cost nothing and the customer cannot change their quantity, in the classic cart and in the Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • Your own text in place of the gift price: one general text in WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Free gifts, and an optional text for each gift on the coupon (“Free!” by default).
  • Gifts are removed automatically if the coupon is removed or stops being valid.
  • Optional free shipping for gifts.
  • Gift items are marked in the order screen.
  • Works with WooCommerce usage restrictions and limits (minimum spend, allowed emails, products, expiry date, etc.).
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • Translation-ready.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the .zip file, or install it from the plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
sections.faq:
How do I create a gift coupon?

Go to Marketing > Coupons > Add coupon. On the General tab, set “Discount type” to “Free Gift”, search for the products in the “Free gifts” field and set the quantities. Publish the coupon.

Which products can be gifts?

Simple, digital and grouped products, and a specific variation of a variable product.

Can the customer change the gift quantity?

No. The quantity is fixed by the coupon and is enforced on the server.

How do I change the “Free!” text?

Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Free gifts. You can also set a different text for each gift on the coupon.

Can I style the “Free!” text?

Yes. It has the CSS class mcgw-gift-label. In the Cart and Checkout blocks, the gift row also has the class mcgw-gift-item.
